     private fun openUrl(url: String) {
         val uri = runCatching { Uri.parse(url) }.getOrNull()
         if (uri == null || uri.scheme != "https" || !isTrustedUpdateHost(uri.host)) {
             toast("Некорректная ссылка обновления")
             return
         }
         runCatching {
             startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri))
         }.onFailure { toast("Не удалось открыть ссылку") }
     }
 
     private fun isTrustedUpdateHost(host: String?): Boolean {
         val value = host?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
         return value == "github.com" ||
             value == "githubusercontent.com" ||
             value.endsWith(".github.com") ||
             value.endsWith(".githubusercontent.com")
     }

     private fun renderCards() {
         cardsBox.removeAllViews()
         val filtered = allApps.filter { matches(it) }
         if (filtered.isEmpty()) {
             val empty = tv("Ничего не найдено", 14f, Color.parseColor("#66667a"))
             empty.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
             empty.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(140))
             cardsBox.addView(empty)
             return
         }
         val cols = maxOf(1, resources.configuration.screenWidthDp / MIN_CARD_WIDTH_DP)
         var i = 0
         while (i < filtered.size) {
             val row = hBox()
             row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
             for (c in 0 until cols) {
                 val cell = vBox()
                 cell.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                 cell.setPadding(dp(4), dp(6), dp(4), dp(6))
                 if (i + c < filtered.size) cell.addView(buildCard(filtered[i + c]))
                 row.addView(cell)
             }
             cardsBox.addView(row)
             i += cols
         }
     }

     private fun miniBtn(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit): Button {

     private fun toggleKeep(pkg: String) {
         val keep = pkg !in keptPkgs
         if (keep && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && !hasOverlayPermission()) {
             toast("Для автоперезапуска включите отображение поверх других окон")
             requestOverlayPermission()
             return
         }
         if (!keeper.set(pkg, keep)) {
             toast("Не удалось изменить keep-alive")
             return
         }
         keptPkgs = if (keep) keptPkgs + pkg else keptPkgs - pkg
         if (!keep) {
             pinnedPkgs = pinnedPkgs - pkg
             overlayFor(pkg, show = false)
         }
         lastSig = ""
         renderCards()
         updateStats()
         updateProcessPane()
     }
 
     private fun launch(pkg: String) {
         val ok = runCatching {
             val i = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg) ?: return@runCatching false
             i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
             startActivity(i)
             true
         }.getOrDefault(false)
         if (!ok) toast("Не удалось запустить $pkg")
     }
 
     private fun launchAdjacent(pkg: String) {
         val ok = runCatching {
             val i = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg) ?: return@runCatching false
             i.addFlags(
                 Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                     Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_ADJACENT
             )
             startActivity(i, ActivityOptions.makeBasic().toBundle())
             true
         }.getOrDefault(false)
         if (!ok) toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg рядом")
     }
 
     private fun launchMini(pkg: String) {
         launchMini(pkg, 0)
     }
 
     private fun launchMini(pkg: String, offset: Int) {
         val launch = runCatching {
             packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg)
         }.getOrNull()
         if (launch == null) {
             toast("Не удалось найти приложение $pkg")
             return
         }
         launch.addFlags(
             Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                 Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK or
                 Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RETAIN_IN_RECENTS
         )
         val requestedOffset = if (offset == 0 && pkg !in miniBoundsByPackage) {
             miniBoundsByPackage.size * 2
         } else {
             offset
         }
         val bounds = miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] ?: miniWindowBounds(requestedOffset).also {
             miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] = Rect(it)
         }
         val launchedInWindow = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
             runCatching {
                 val options = ActivityOptions.makeBasic().apply {
                     setLaunchBounds(bounds)
                     setFreeformModeBestEffort()
                 }
                 startActivity(launch, options.toBundle())
                 true
             }.getOrDefault(false)
         } else {
             false
         }
         if (launchedInWindow) {
             showOverlayOrRequest(pkg, bounds)
             return

Веб-части нет. - `android/keystore.properties` и `android/keystore/` — локальные файлы для release-подписи; они не должны попадать в репозиторий. - `docs/` — обложка репозитория. ## Сборка ``` cd android ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug # debug (нужен SDK, адрес в local.properties) ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease # release; при наличии локального keystore.properties ``` Release получает версию из текущего git-тега. Для подписи нужно создать `android/keystore.properties` с параметрами локального keystore; файл и ключ исключены из репозитория. Без этих параметров сборка release останавливается с ошибкой, а не использует выдуманные значения. Если ключ раньше был опубликован, его нужно считать скомпрометированным и заменить новым. ## Как выкатить release ``` git tag v1.0.1 (cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease) apksigner verify --verbose android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk git push origin main --tags gh release create v1.0.1 android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk --title v1.0.1 ``` `Updater` проверяет именно опубликованный GitHub Release и показывает его, если в release есть APK-asset. Одного тега недостаточно. ## Что делает приложение - `MainActivity` — поиск, сетка карточек, тумблер keep/pin, панель процессов, мультиоконный и мини-оконный запуск, автообновление каждые 2.5 с, проверка обновлений при запуске. - `AppKeeper` — хранит списки «держимых» и «пинованных» пакетов в SharedPreferences и синхронизирует foreground-сервис. - `KeepAliveService` — ватчдог на wake lock: каждые 2 с проверяет `runningAppProcesses` и поднимает умерший процесс заново (пинованные — сразу в мини-окно); восстанавливает списки после перезапуска системой. - `Updater` — запрашивает `releases/latest` с GitHub, проверяет наличие APK и открывает ссылку на скачивание, если найдена более новая версия. ## Ограничения Android (workarounds) - Для списка launcher-приложений используется `` с `MAIN/LAUNCHER`; `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` не запрашивается. - На Android 10+ фоновый запуск приложений ограничен, поэтому обёртка использует foreground-сервис типа `specialUse` с удержанием wake lock. Автоматический перезапуск — best effort и зависит от разрешений и текущей политики Android. - На Android 10+ для автоматического перезапуска требуется разрешение `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`; без него Android может заблокировать запуск Activity. - На Android 13+ запрашивается разрешение `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`. - Мини-окна (`setLaunchBounds` + best-effort freeform-режим) раскрываются в интерактивные свободные окна на системах с поддержкой freeform (планшеты, десктоп-режим, Android 15+ с несколькими окнами); на обычных телефонах без freeform приложение открывается обычным запуском. Android не даёт сторонним приложениям уходить в системный PiP, поэтому именно freeform — единственный путь к «приложению в маленьком интерактивном окне».

472:     private fun scaleWindow(pkg: String, factor: Float) {
473:         val cur = lastBounds[pkg] ?: miniBounds().also { lastBounds[pkg] = it }
474:         val width = screenWidth()

476:         var w = (cur.width() * factor).toInt()
477:         var h = (cur.height() * factor).toInt()
478:         w = w.coerceIn((width * 0.26f).toInt(), (width * 0.96f).toInt())
479:         h = h.coerceIn((height * 0.26f).toInt(), (height * 0.96f).toInt())

496:         positionPreset[pkg] = idx
497:         val (grav, ax, ay) = ANCHORS[idx]
498:         val leftInset = dp(ax)
499:         val topInset = dp(ay)
500:         var r = when (grav) {
501:             Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.START -> Rect(leftInset, dh - h - topInset, w + leftInset, dh - topInset)
502:             Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.END -> Rect(dw - w - leftInset, dh - h - topInset, dw - leftInset, dh - topInset)
503:             Gravity.TOP or Gravity.END -> Rect(dw - w - leftInset, topInset, dw - leftInset, h + topInset)
504:             Gravity.CENTER or Gravity.END -> Rect(dw - w - leftInset, (dh - h) / 2, dw - leftInset, (dh + h) / 2)
505:             Gravity.CENTER -> Rect((dw - w) / 2, (dh - h) / 2, (dw + w) / 2, (dh + h) / 2)
506:             else -> Rect(leftInset, topInset, w + leftInset, h + topInset)

135:     private fun openUrl(url: String) {
136:         val uri = runCatching { Uri.parse(url) }.getOrNull()
137:         if (uri == null || uri.scheme != "https" || !isTrustedUpdateHost(uri.host)) {
138:             toast("Некорректная ссылка обновления")
139:             return
140:         }
141:         runCatching {
142:             startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri))
143:         }.onFailure { toast("Не удалось открыть ссылку") }
144:     }

146:     private fun isTrustedUpdateHost(host: String?): Boolean {
147:         val value = host?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
148:         return value == "github.com" ||
149:             value == "githubusercontent.com" ||
150:             value.endsWith(".github.com") ||
151:             value.endsWith(".githubusercontent.com")
152:     }

289:         }
290:         val cols = maxOf(1, resources.configuration.screenWidthDp / MIN_CARD_WIDTH_DP)
291:         var i = 0
292:         while (i < filtered.size) {
293:             val row = hBox()
294:             row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
295:             for (c in 0 until cols) {

300:                 row.addView(cell)
301:             }
302:             cardsBox.addView(row)
303:             i += cols
304:         }
305:     }

473:     private fun toggleKeep(pkg: String) {
474:         val keep = pkg !in keptPkgs
475:         if (keep && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && !hasOverlayPermission()) {
476:             toast("Для автоперезапуска включите отображение поверх других окон")
477:             requestOverlayPermission()
478:             return
479:         }
480:         if (!keeper.set(pkg, keep)) {
481:             toast("Не удалось изменить keep-alive")
482:             return
483:         }
484:         keptPkgs = if (keep) keptPkgs + pkg else keptPkgs - pkg
485:         if (!keep) {
486:             pinnedPkgs = pinnedPkgs - pkg
487:             overlayFor(pkg, show = false)
488:         }
489:         lastSig = ""
490:         renderCards()
491:         updateStats()
492:         updateProcessPane()
493:     }

522:     private fun launchMini(pkg: String, offset: Int) {
523:         val launch = runCatching {
524:             packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg)
525:         }.getOrNull()
526:         if (launch == null) {
527:             toast("Не удалось найти приложение $pkg")
528:             return
529:         }
530:         launch.addFlags(
531:             Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
532:                 Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK or
533:                 Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RETAIN_IN_RECENTS
534:         )
535:         val requestedOffset = if (offset == 0 && pkg !in miniBoundsByPackage) {
536:             miniBoundsByPackage.size * 2
537:         } else {
538:             offset
539:         }
540:         val bounds = miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] ?: miniWindowBounds(requestedOffset).also {
541:             miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] = Rect(it)
542:         }
543:         val launchedInWindow = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
544:             runCatching {
545:                 val options = ActivityOptions.makeBasic().apply {
546:                     setLaunchBounds(bounds)
547:                     setFreeformModeBestEffort()
548:                 }
549:                 startActivity(launch, options.toBundle())
550:                 true
551:             }.getOrDefault(false)
552:         } else {
553:             false
554:         }
555:         if (launchedInWindow) {
556:             showOverlayOrRequest(pkg, bounds)
557:             return
558:         }
559:         val opened = runCatching {
560:             startActivity(launch)
561:             true
562:         }.getOrDefault(false)
563:         if (opened) {
564:             toast("Свободное окно недоступно — открыто обычное окно")
565:         } else {
566:             toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg")
567:         }
568:     }

582:         val gap = dp(14)

584:         val maxY = (screenHeight() - h - gap).coerceAtLeast(0)
585:         val step = dp(32)
586:         val maxSteps = minOf(maxX, maxY) / step
587:         val steps = offset.coerceIn(0, maxSteps)
588:         val x = (maxX - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)
589:         val y = (maxY - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)

685:         val seen = HashSet<String>()

package dev.apk.launcher

import android.Manifest
import android.app.ActivityOptions
import android.content.Intent

import android.widget.EditText

import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.ScrollView
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import java.util.Locale

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    private class AppEntry(
        val packageName: String,
        val label: String,
        val versionName: String,
        val icon: Drawable?,
    )

    private data class ProcEntry(
        val packageName: String,
        val pid: Int,
        val importance: String,
    )

    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val keeper by lazy { AppKeeper(applicationContext) }

    private var allApps: List<AppEntry> = emptyList()
    private var processes: List<ProcEntry> = emptyList()
    private var keptPkgs: Set<String> = emptySet()
    private var pinnedPkgs: Set<String> = emptySet()
    private var query = ""
    private var showKeptOnly = false
    private var lastSig = ""

    private lateinit var statAppsNum: TextView
    private lateinit var statAppsLabel: TextView
    private lateinit var statAliveNum: TextView
    private lateinit var statSplitNum: TextView
    private lateinit var scrollContent: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var cardsBox: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var processPanel: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var updateBar: LinearLayout

    private val refresh = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            loadProcesses()
            render()
            handler.postDelayed(this, REFRESH_MS)
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        buildUi()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        maybeRequestNotifPermission()
        loadApps()
        keptPkgs = keeper.list().toSet()
        pinnedPkgs = keeper.pinnedList().toSet()
        keeper.syncService()
        showPendingOverlays()
        loadProcesses()
        lastSig = ""
        render()
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        handler.post(refresh)
        checkForUpdate()
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        super.onPause()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun maybeRequestNotifPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU &&
            checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS), 100)
        }
    }

    private fun checkForUpdate() {
        Updater.check(this, BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME) { latest, url ->
            updateUrl = url
            updateBar.removeAllViews()
            val title = tv("Обновление $latest доступно", 14f, Color.parseColor("#4ade80"), Typeface.BOLD)
            updateBar.addView(title)
            val btns = hBox()
            btns.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            btns.addView(miniBtn("скачать APK") { openUrl(updateUrl) }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            btns.addView(miniBtn("позже") { updateBar.visibility = View.GONE }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            val blp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            blp.topMargin = dp(8)
            btns.layoutParams = blp
            updateBar.addView(btns)
            updateBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }
    }

    private fun openUrl(url: String) {
        val uri = runCatching { Uri.parse(url) }.getOrNull()
        if (uri == null || uri.scheme != "https" || !isTrustedUpdateHost(uri.host)) {
            toast("Некорректная ссылка обновления")
            return
        }
        runCatching {
            startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri))
        }.onFailure { toast("Не удалось открыть ссылку") }
    }

    private fun isTrustedUpdateHost(host: String?): Boolean {
        val value = host?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
        return value == "github.com" ||
            value == "githubusercontent.com" ||
            value.endsWith(".github.com") ||
            value.endsWith(".githubusercontent.com")
    }

    private var updateUrl = ""
    private val pendingOverlays = HashMap<String, Rect>()
    private val miniBoundsByPackage = HashMap<String, Rect>()

    private fun buildUi() {
        val root = vBox()
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#0d0d12"))
        setContentView(root)

        val header = vBox()
        header.setPadding(dp(16), dp(12), dp(16), dp(4))
        val titleRow = hBox()
        titleRow.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        titleRow.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        titleRow.addView(tv("APK Launcher", 20f, Color.WHITE, Typeface.BOLD))
        val versionTv = tv(BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME, 12f, Color.parseColor("#22c55e"), Typeface.BOLD)
        versionTv.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.pill_keep_on)
        versionTv.setPadding(dp(8), dp(1), dp(8), dp(1))
        val vlp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        vlp.setMargins(dp(10), 0, 0, 0)
        versionTv.layoutParams = vlp
        titleRow.addView(versionTv)
        header.addView(titleRow)

        updateBar = vBox()
        updateBar.visibility = View.GONE
        updateBar.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_update)
        updateBar.setPadding(dp(12), dp(10), dp(12), dp(10))
        val ublp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        ublp.setMargins(dp(16), dp(10), dp(16), 0)
        updateBar.layoutParams = ublp
        header.addView(updateBar)

        val search = EditText(this)
        search.hint = "Поиск приложений…"
        search.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#e8e8f0"))
        search.setHintTextColor(Color.parseColor("#66667a"))
        search.textSize = 15f
        search.isSingleLine = true
        search.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search)
        search.setPadding(dp(12), 0, dp(12), 0)
        val slp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(40))
        slp.setMargins(0, dp(10), 0, 0)
        search.layoutParams = slp
        search.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, a: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, a: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {
                query = s?.toString() ?: ""
                lastSig = ""
                renderCards()
            }

            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {}
        })
        header.addView(search)
        root.addView(header)

        val keepbar = hBox()
        keepbar.setPadding(dp(12), dp(10), dp(12), dp(4))
        val statApps = statColumn()
        statApps.setOnClickListener {
            showKeptOnly = !showKeptOnly
            lastSig = ""
            renderCards()
            updateStats()
        }
        statAppsNum = statsNum(statApps)
        statAppsLabel = statsLabel(statApps, "приложений")
        keepbar.addView(statApps)

        val statAlive = statColumn()
        statAliveNum = statsNum(statAlive)
        statsLabel(statAlive, "держится")
        keepbar.addView(statAlive)

        val statRefresh = statColumn()
        val refreshNum = statsNum(statRefresh)
        refreshNum.text = "⟳"
        refreshNum.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#66667a"))
        statsLabel(statRefresh, "обновить")
        statRefresh.setOnClickListener {
            loadApps()
            keptPkgs = keeper.list().toSet()
            pinnedPkgs = keeper.pinnedList().toSet()
            loadProcesses()
            lastSig = ""
            render()
        }
        keepbar.addView(statRefresh)

        val statSplit = statColumn()
        statSplitNum = statsNum(statSplit)
        statsLabel(statSplit, "все мини")
        statSplit.setOnClickListener { openKeptInMiniWindows() }
        keepbar.addView(statSplit)
        root.addView(keepbar)

        val scroller = ScrollView(this)
        scroller.isFillViewport = false
        scrollContent = vBox()
        scroller.addView(scrollContent, ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT))
        root.addView(scroller, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f))

        cardsBox = vBox()
        cardsBox.setPadding(0, dp(4), 0, dp(4))
        scrollContent.addView(cardsBox)

        processPanel = vBox()
        processPanel.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_panel)
        val plp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        plp.setMargins(dp(16), dp(8), dp(16), dp(16))
        processPanel.layoutParams = plp
        processPanel.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(12))
        scrollContent.addView(processPanel)
    }

    private fun render() {
        val sig = sig()
        if (sig != lastSig) {
            renderCards()
            lastSig = sig
        }
        updateStats()
        updateProcessPane()
    }

    private fun renderCards() {
        cardsBox.removeAllViews()
        val filtered = allApps.filter { matches(it) }
        if (filtered.isEmpty()) {
            val empty = tv("Ничего не найдено", 14f, Color.parseColor("#66667a"))
            empty.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            empty.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(140))
            cardsBox.addView(empty)
            return
        }
        val cols = maxOf(1, resources.configuration.screenWidthDp / MIN_CARD_WIDTH_DP)

        while (i < filtered.size) {
            val row = hBox()
            row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)

                val cell = vBox()
                cell.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)

                row.addView(cell)
            }
            cardsBox.addView(row)
            i += cols
        }
    }

    private fun buildCard(app: AppEntry): View {
        val kept = app.packageName in keptPkgs

        val alive = running(app.packageName)

        val card = vBox()

        card.setPadding(dp(12), dp(12), dp(12), dp(10))

        val main = vBox()
        main.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
        main.setOnClickListener { launch(app.packageName) }
        card.addView(main)

        val icon = ImageView(this)
        icon.scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
        val ilp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(52), dp(52))
        ilp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
        icon.layoutParams = ilp
        icon.setImageDrawable(app.icon ?: getDrawable(android.R.drawable.sym_def_app_icon))
        main.addView(icon)

        val label = tv(app.label, 14f, Color.WHITE, Typeface.BOLD)
        label.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        label.maxLines = 2
        label.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        main.addView(label)

        val ver = tv(
            if (app.versionName.isEmpty()) app.packageName else app.versionName,
            11f,
            Color.parseColor("#66667a"),
        )
        ver.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        ver.maxLines = 1
        main.addView(ver)

        val row = hBox()
        row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        card.addView(row)

        row.addView(
            tv(if (alive) "работает" else "спит", 11f,
                if (alive) Color.parseColor("#4ade80") else Color.parseColor("#66667a")),
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f),
        )

        val keepBtn = Button(this)
        keepBtn.text = if (kept) "снять keep" else "keep"
        keepBtn.textSize = 12f
        keepBtn.isAllCaps = false
        keepBtn.minimumWidth = 0
        keepBtn.minimumHeight = 0
        keepBtn.setTextColor(if (kept) Color.parseColor("#4ade80") else Color.parseColor("#b9b9cc"))
        keepBtn.setBackgroundResource(if (kept) R.drawable.pill_keep_on else R.drawable.pill_keep_off)
        keepBtn.setOnClickListener { toggleKeep(app.packageName) }
        row.addView(keepBtn)

        val btnRow = hBox()
        btnRow.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
            topMargin = dp(4)
        }

        val pinBtn = miniBtn("пин") { togglePin(app.packageName) }
        pinBtn.setTextColor(if (pinned) Color.parseColor("#4ade80") else Color.parseColor("#b9b9cc"))
        pinBtn.setBackgroundResource(if (pinned) R.drawable.pill_keep_on else R.drawable.pill_keep_off)
        btnRow.addView(pinBtn, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))

        btnRow.addView(miniBtn("окно") { launchAdjacent(app.packageName) },
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
        btnRow.addView(miniBtn("мини") { launchMini(app.packageName) },
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
        card.addView(btnRow)
        return card
    }

    private fun updateStats() {
        statAppsNum.text = String.format(
            Locale.getDefault(),
            "%d",
            if (showKeptOnly) keptPkgs.size else allApps.size,
        )
        statAppsLabel.text = if (showKeptOnly) "на keep" else "приложений"
        statAliveNum.text = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d", keptPkgs.count { running(it) })
        statSplitNum.text = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d", keptPkgs.size)
    }

    private fun updateProcessPane() {
        processPanel.removeAllViews()
        if (processes.isEmpty() && keptPkgs.isEmpty()) {
            processPanel.visibility = View.GONE
            return
        }
        processPanel.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        val title = tv("Процессы (${processes.size})", 15f, Color.WHITE, Typeface.BOLD)
        processPanel.addView(title)
        for (p in processes) {
            processPanel.addView(buildProcRow(p))
        }
    }

    private fun buildProcRow(p: ProcEntry): View {
        val base = p.packageName.substringBefore(':')
        val kept = base in keptPkgs
        val pinned = base in pinnedPkgs
        val row = hBox()
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_proc_row)
        row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT).apply {
            topMargin = dp(6)
        }
        row.setPadding(dp(8), dp(6), dp(8), dp(6))

        val icon = ImageView(this)
        icon.scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
        icon.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(24), dp(24))
        icon.setImageDrawable(
            runCatching { packageManager.getApplicationIcon(base) }.getOrNull()
                ?: getDrawable(android.R.drawable.sym_def_app_icon),
        )
        row.addView(icon)

        val name = tv(p.packageName, 13f, Color.WHITE)
        name.maxLines = 1
        name.ellipsize = android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
        val nlp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        nlp.setMargins(dp(8), 0, dp(8), 0)
        name.layoutParams = nlp
        row.addView(name)

        val state = tv(
            if (kept) "keep" else p.importance,
            11f,
            if (kept) Color.parseColor("#4ade80") else Color.parseColor("#f87171"),
        )
        state.setBackgroundResource(if (kept) R.drawable.pill_state_on else R.drawable.pill_state_off)
        state.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        state.setPadding(dp(8), dp(2), dp(8), dp(2))
        row.addView(state)

        val pinBtn = miniBtn("пин") { togglePin(base) }
        pinBtn.setTextColor(if (pinned) Color.parseColor("#4ade80") else Color.parseColor("#b9b9cc"))
        pinBtn.setBackgroundResource(if (pinned) R.drawable.pill_keep_on else R.drawable.pill_keep_off)
        row.addView(pinBtn)
        row.addView(miniBtn("окно") { launchAdjacent(base) })
        row.addView(miniBtn("мини") { launchMini(base) })
        row.addView(miniBtn("запустить") { launch(base) })
        row.addView(miniBtn(if (kept) "снять keep" else "keep") { toggleKeep(base) })
        return row
    }

    private fun miniBtn(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit): Button {
        val b = Button(this)
        b.text = text
        b.textSize = 11f
        b.isAllCaps = false
        b.minimumWidth = 0
        b.minimumHeight = 0
        b.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#b9b9cc"))
        b.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.pill_keep_off)
        val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        lp.setMargins(dp(4), 0, 0, 0)
        b.layoutParams = lp
        b.setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        return b
    }

    private fun toggleKeep(pkg: String) {
        val keep = pkg !in keptPkgs
        if (keep && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && !hasOverlayPermission()) {
            toast("Для автоперезапуска включите отображение поверх других окон")
            requestOverlayPermission()
            return
        }
        if (!keeper.set(pkg, keep)) {
            toast("Не удалось изменить keep-alive")
            return
        }
        keptPkgs = if (keep) keptPkgs + pkg else keptPkgs - pkg
        if (!keep) {
            pinnedPkgs = pinnedPkgs - pkg
            overlayFor(pkg, show = false)
        }
        lastSig = ""
        renderCards()
        updateStats()
        updateProcessPane()
    }

    private fun launch(pkg: String) {
        val ok = runCatching {
            val i = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg) ?: return@runCatching false
            i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            startActivity(i)
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!ok) toast("Не удалось запустить $pkg")
    }

    private fun launchAdjacent(pkg: String) {
        val ok = runCatching {
            val i = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg) ?: return@runCatching false
            i.addFlags(
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                    Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_ADJACENT
            )
            startActivity(i, ActivityOptions.makeBasic().toBundle())
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!ok) toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg рядом")
    }

    private fun launchMini(pkg: String) {
        launchMini(pkg, 0)
    }

    private fun launchMini(pkg: String, offset: Int) {
        val launch = runCatching {
            packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (launch == null) {
            toast("Не удалось найти приложение $pkg")
            return
        }
        launch.addFlags(
            Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK or
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RETAIN_IN_RECENTS
        )
        val requestedOffset = if (offset == 0 && pkg !in miniBoundsByPackage) {
            miniBoundsByPackage.size * 2
        } else {
            offset
        }
        val bounds = miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] ?: miniWindowBounds(requestedOffset).also {
            miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] = Rect(it)
        }
        val launchedInWindow = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            runCatching {
                val options = ActivityOptions.makeBasic().apply {
                    setLaunchBounds(bounds)
                    setFreeformModeBestEffort()
                }
                startActivity(launch, options.toBundle())
                true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        } else {
            false
        }
        if (launchedInWindow) {
            showOverlayOrRequest(pkg, bounds)
            return
        }
        val opened = runCatching {
            startActivity(launch)
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (opened) {
            toast("Свободное окно недоступно — открыто обычное окно")
        } else {
            toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg")
        }
    }

    private fun openKeptInMiniWindows() {
        val pkgs = keptPkgs.sorted()
        if (pkgs.isEmpty()) {
            toast("Нет приложений на keep")
            return
        }
        pkgs.forEachIndexed { idx, pkg -> launchMini(pkg, idx) }
    }

    private fun miniWindowBounds(offset: Int): Rect {
        val w = (screenWidth() * 0.62f).toInt()
        val h = (screenHeight() * 0.6f).toInt()
        val gap = dp(14)
        val maxX = (screenWidth() - w - gap).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val maxY = (screenHeight() - h - gap).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val step = dp(32)
        val maxSteps = minOf(maxX, maxY) / step
        val steps = offset.coerceIn(0, maxSteps)
        val x = (maxX - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val y = (maxY - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)
        return Rect(x, y, x + w, y + h)
    }

    private fun ActivityOptions.setFreeformModeBestEffort() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            runCatching {
                ActivityOptions::class.java
                    .getMethod("setLaunchWindowingMode", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .invoke(this, WINDOWING_MODE_FREEFORM)
            }
        }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            runCatching {
                ActivityOptions::class.java
                    .getMethod("setLaunchStackId", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .invoke(this, FREEFORM_STACK_ID)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun togglePin(pkg: String) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        val pin = clean !in pinnedPkgs
        if (!keeper.setPin(clean, pin)) {
            toast("Не удалось изменить мини-окно")
            return
        }
        pinnedPkgs = if (pin) pinnedPkgs + clean else pinnedPkgs - clean
        if (pin) keptPkgs = keptPkgs + clean
        lastSig = ""
        renderCards()
        if (pin) launchMini(clean) else overlayFor(clean, show = false)
    }

    private fun showOverlayOrRequest(pkg: String, bounds: Rect) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        if (hasOverlayPermission()) {
            pendingOverlays.remove(clean)
            overlayFor(clean, show = true, bounds = bounds)
            return
        }
        pendingOverlays[clean] = Rect(bounds)
        requestOverlayPermission()
        toast("Включите «отображение поверх других окон» для кнопок мини-окна")
    }

    private fun requestOverlayPermission() {
        runCatching {
            startActivity(
                Intent(
                    Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                    Uri.parse("package:$packageName"),
                )
            )
        }.onFailure {
            toast("Не удалось открыть настройки разрешения")
        }
    }

    private fun showPendingOverlays() {
        if (!hasOverlayPermission() || pendingOverlays.isEmpty()) return
        val pending = pendingOverlays.toMap()
        pendingOverlays.clear()
        pending.forEach { (pkg, bounds) -> overlayFor(pkg, show = true, bounds = bounds) }
    }

    private fun hasOverlayPermission(): Boolean =
        Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.M || Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)

    private fun overlayFor(pkg: String, show: Boolean, bounds: Rect? = null) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        val i = Intent(this, KeepAliveService::class.java)
            .setAction(
                if (show) KeepAliveService.ACTION_SHOW_OVERLAY
                else KeepAliveService.ACTION_HIDE_OVERLAY
            )
            .putExtra(KeepAliveService.EXTRA_PKG, clean)
        if (bounds != null) i.putExtra(KeepAliveService.EXTRA_BOUNDS, bounds)
        runCatching {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                startForegroundService(i)
            } else {
                startService(i)
            }
        }.onFailure {
            toast("Не удалось запустить панель мини-окна")
        }
    }

    private fun loadApps() {
        val pm = packageManager
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        val resolved = runCatching { pm.queryIntentActivities(intent, 0) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        val seen = HashSet<String>()
        val apps = ArrayList<AppEntry>()
        for (ri in resolved) {
            val pkg = ri.activityInfo.packageName
            if (pkg == packageName) continue
            if (!seen.add(pkg)) continue
            val label = runCatching {
                pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString()
            }.getOrDefault(pkg)
            val version = runCatching { pm.getPackageInfo(pkg, 0).versionName ?: "" }.getOrDefault("")
            val icon = runCatching { pm.getApplicationIcon(pkg) }.getOrNull()
            apps.add(AppEntry(pkg, label, version, icon))
        }
        apps.sortBy { it.label.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        allApps = apps
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun loadProcesses() {
        val am = getSystemService(ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as android.app.ActivityManager
        val running = am.runningAppProcesses ?: emptyList()
        val list = ArrayList<ProcEntry>()
        for (p in running) {
            if (p.importance <= 0 ||
                p.importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_EMPTY
            ) {
                continue
            }
            list.add(ProcEntry(p.processName, p.pid, importanceName(p.importance)))
        }
        processes = list
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun importanceName(importance: Int): String = when {
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_GONE -> "gone"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_EMPTY -> "empty"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_BACKGROUND -> "background"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_TOP_SLEEPING -> "sleeping"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_SERVICE -> "service"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_PERCEPTIBLE -> "perceptible"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_VISIBLE -> "visible"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND_SERVICE -> "сервис"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
        else -> "unknown"
    }

    private fun running(pkg: String): Boolean =
        processes.any { p -> p.packageName == pkg || p.packageName.startsWith("$pkg:") }

    private fun matches(a: AppEntry): Boolean {
        if (showKeptOnly && a.packageName !in keptPkgs) return false
        val q = query.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        return q.isEmpty() ||
            a.label.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q) ||
            a.packageName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q)
    }

    private fun sig(): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append(query).append('|').append(showKeptOnly).append('|')
        for (a in allApps) {
            if (!matches(a)) continue
            sb.append(a.packageName)
            sb.append(if (a.packageName in keptPkgs) '1' else '0')
            sb.append(if (a.packageName in pinnedPkgs) '1' else '0')
            sb.append(if (running(a.packageName)) '1' else '0')
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    private fun statColumn(): LinearLayout {
        val v = vBox()
        v.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        v.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_stat)
        v.setPadding(dp(10), dp(8), dp(10), dp(8))
        v.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f).apply {
            setMargins(dp(4), 0, dp(4), 0)
        }
        return v
    }

    private fun statsNum(parent: LinearLayout): TextView {
        val t = tv("0", 22f, Color.WHITE, Typeface.BOLD)
        parent.addView(t)
        return t
    }

    private fun statsLabel(parent: LinearLayout, text: String): TextView {
        val t = tv(text, 11f, Color.parseColor("#8a8a9e"))
        parent.addView(t)
        return t
    }

    private fun hBox(): LinearLayout {
        val v = LinearLayout(this)
        v.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        v.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        return v
    }

    private fun vBox(): LinearLayout {
        val v = LinearLayout(this)
        v.orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        return v
    }

    private fun tv(text: String, sp: Float, color: Int, style: Int = Typeface.NORMAL): TextView {
        val t = TextView(this)
        t.text = text
        t.textSize = sp
        t.setTextColor(color)
        t.setTypeface(Typeface.DEFAULT, style)
        return t
    }

    private fun toast(msg: String) {
        Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun screenWidth(): Int = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
        runCatching {
            (getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager).maximumWindowMetrics.bounds.width()
        }.getOrDefault(resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels)
    } else {
        resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels
    }

    private fun screenHeight(): Int = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
        runCatching {
            (getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager).maximumWindowMetrics.bounds.height()
        }.getOrDefault(resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels)
    } else {
        resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels
    }

    private fun dp(v: Int): Int = (v * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    companion object {
        const val KEEP_EXTRA = "keep_pkgs"
        const val PIN_EXTRA = "pin_pkgs"
        private const val REFRESH_MS = 2500L
        private const val MIN_CARD_WIDTH_DP = 150
        private const val WINDOWING_MODE_FREEFORM = 5
        private const val FREEFORM_STACK_ID = 2
    }
}

Now I understand the codebase. The user wants energy/battery improvements. Let me identify the main battery drains:

**KeepAliveService (the biggest drain — runs 24/7 in foreground with a PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK held forever):**

1. `wakeLock.acquire()` with no timeout — held permanently. `@SuppressLint("WakelockTimeout")`. This prevents the CPU from ever sleeping. Key optimizations:

### KeepAliveService (biggest drain, 24/7)
1. **Wake lock**: acquire only for the duration of a tick with a timeout, release right after. Currently held forever → CPU never idles.
2. **Adaptive polling**: 
   - base 2s when "active" (something needs action: a process is dead and pending relaunch, overlay is missing but pinned, or recently changed state)
   - back off to 5s when stable
   - back off to 15s (or 30s when screen off) when everything is stable
   - immediately drop to fast when the screen turns on / a relaunch is due (listen to ACTION_SCREEN_ON? Registering a receiver in a service for screen on is a good "wake up fast" signal. That is cheap: a manifest-less runtime receiver in onCreate. But ACTION_SCREEN_ON requires the receiver to be registered; it's allowed. Let me add it — register in onCreate, unregister in onDestroy.)
3. **Don't call getRunningTasks every tick** — only when a relaunch decision is actually pending (a kept process is dead and past the cooldown). Fall back to the cheap importance check otherwise.
4. **Precompute a process-name → running set** once per tick instead of O(N*M) scans.
5. **saveState() only when dirty** and on state transitions; drop the unconditional 30s write.
6. **Cache activePackages()** per tick instead of allocating 3x.
7. **Notification**: only rebuild/update when the text changes.

Careful about behavior preservation: relaunch timing. With adaptive backoff, worst case detection delay grows. To preserve responsiveness, use the "pending relaunch" fast path: if a kept process was alive on the previous tick and is now dead, we're at the "just died" stage. The relaunch requires `now - lastAliveAt >= RELAUNCH_MIN_GAP_MS` (15s) which means we must NOT relaunch immediately anyway — the cooldown is 15 s. So polling at 5s instead of 2s barely changes the relaunch timing (granularity goes from 2s to 5s on a 15s cooldown). That's a very safe tradeoff. I'll use: FAST 2s while unstable/at-risk, NORMAL 5s stable, IDLE 15s stable + screen off.

Hmm, but also the overlay show for pinned: `if (pkg in pinned && !overlays.containsKey(pkg)) showOverlay(pkg)` — happens on any alive tick. Backoff to 5s means the overlay appears up to 5s later. Acceptable. Actually, better: we can show the overlay right at relaunch time (relaunch already calls showOverlay for pinned). So overlay latency is mostly covered.

To be safe, I'll make the "hot" conditions explicit:
- any kept package currently dead (not alive) → FAST
- overlays exist and screen is on → NORMAL (they need positioning/verification)
- all alive, screen off → IDLE (15s)
- all alive, screen on → NORMAL (5s)

That's a solid design. And I keep WATCH_INTERVAL_MS = 2000 as the fast interval, so worst case behavior is identical to today in the hot state.

### MainActivity
1. **Icon cache** (packageName → Drawable) so `getApplicationIcon` is not called per row per tick.
2. **`updateProcessPane()` rebuild only on signature change** (pid, importance, kept, pinned) instead of every 2.5s.
3. **`loadApps()` cache**: keep `allApps` across resumes; only reload if the installed-launcher set changed. Cheap check: compare the sorted package list? That requires queryIntentActivities which is a binder call, but it doesn't load icons — cheap-ish. Better: keep a process-wide cache of apps keyed by nothing, and refresh it when the package name list changes. I'll compute the package list each resume (cheap binder call, no icons) and only rebuild AppEntry (with icons) if it differs from the cached list.
4. **Adaptive UI refresh**: 2.5s while something is changing, back off to 8-10s when stable. Also skip `loadProcesses()` when interval is long? No, still needed but it's one binder call.
5. **Throttle Updater.check** to at most once per 6 hours (persist last check time in prefs) — network radio wakeups are expensive.
6. `sig()` string building: only for visible apps; keep but avoid `String.format` in updateStats (use setText with Int → cheap). Minor; I'll use `text = n.toString()`.
7. Also `updateStats()` calls `keptPkgs.count { running(it) }` where `running()` does a linear scan over processes with startsWith → O(K*P). Build a Set of running base packages once per tick. Also used by `buildCard` and `sig()` per app → O(A*P) with 200 apps × 50 procs = 10k startsWith per 2.5s. Precompute a `runningBase: Set<String>` and a `runningAny: Set<String>` (full process names) → O(1) lookups. This is a real CPU win.

### AppKeeper
1. Throttle `pruneMissingPackages` (process-wide, at most once per N seconds) and skip if prefs empty.
2. Reuse a single instance where cheap (MainActivity's toggleKeep/togglePin use `keeper` already? `toggleKeep` uses `keeper` — good. `detachWindow` in the service creates a new one — fine, it'll be throttled).

parts.text:
Baseline build works. Now let me implement the optimizations.

Let me create a todo list first.

Plan:
1. KeepAliveService: scoped wake lock, adaptive polling, cheap launcher-focus check, O(1) process lookups, dirty-only state save, cached activePackages, notification only on change.
2. MainActivity: running-process set, icon cache, process pane signature-based rebuild, adaptive UI refresh, app list cache across resumes, throttled updater check.
3. AppKeeper: throttled pruning.
4. Update README docs where behavior/timings changed.
5. Build + lint verification.

Let me start with KeepAliveService.

### KeepAliveService details

Replace the watchdog:
```kotlin
private val watchdog = object : Runnable {
    override fun run() {
        if (!running) return
        acquireWakeLock()
        val next = try {
            ensureKeptProcesses()
        } finally {
            releaseWakeLock()
        }
        handler.postDelayed(this, next)
    }
}
```

Wake lock with timeout: `wakeLock.acquire(WAKE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)` — using the timeout overload, so even if something goes wrong it auto-releases. Remove the `@SuppressLint("WakelockTimeout")` for the no-arg acquire.

Important consideration: releasing the wakelock after each tick means the device can sleep between ticks. But will the postDelayed runnable still fire on time? With a foreground service and no wakelock, the CPU may be in suspend, and the timer will wake it. Android's handler-based timers use the uptime clock, and the kernel will wake the CPU from suspend when a timer expires (this is standard: `postDelayed` in a non-wakelock context is subject to delay in deep sleep, but on modern devices with doze the CPU still wakes for timers — the delay could be up to a few minutes in Doze for non-exempt apps, but a foreground service is not Doze-deferred... Actually, apps in the foreground with an active FGS are not in the Doze allowlist by default; in Doze, timers can be deferred significantly.

Hmm, this is a real concern: with wakelock released, the 2s handler tick could be deferred in Doze to a much longer interval, breaking keep-alive promptness. But wait — that's a battery win too... but it changes functionality.

Hmm, let's think about what actually keeps the CPU awake. The wakelock is PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK which prevents suspend. Without it, the CPU suspends and only wakes on timer expiry — but Android's `AlarmManager`/handler timers do wake the CPU from suspend (suspend-to-RAM is entered with a wakeup timer). The main issue is Doze's `deep doze` (device idle), where the CPU may stay suspended and alarms are batched to every ~30 min for non-allowlisted apps.

In practice, a FGS with a wakelock is the current design and it drains battery hard. A good middle ground widely used: keep the wakelock but use a *timeout-bounded* acquire around the work, and rely on the fact that the service is a foreground service (FGS apps get a temporary allowlist on Android 12+... actually apps with a running FGS are added to the power allowlist in many Android versions, which limits Doze deferral).

Better and much more robust approach for low power + reliable timing: **use AlarmManager with `setExactAndAllowWhileIdle` (or `setAndAllowWhileIdle`) for the next tick instead of (or in addition to) a permanent wakelock.** But SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is needed for exact alarms on Android 12+, and `USE_EXACT_ALARM` requires justification (Play policy). `setAndAllowWhileIdle` (inexact but doze-aware) doesn't need any permission and fires at least every ~9 minutes in Doze, more often when the device is idle. Hmm, that would make relaunch detection up to 9 min late in Doze. That's the Doze reality anyway — nothing can relaunch an app every 2s in Doze without a wakelock.

Practical, honest design that gives real battery wins without breaking the core feature:

- Hold the wakelock only while there's actual work to do OR when recently active (a short "burst" window), and release it during long stable periods. i.e. **scoped wakelock + adaptive interval**. When stable, we poll every 15s with a scoped wakelock — this means the CPU is awake only ~a few ms per 15s instead of 100% of the time. That's a huge battery win and the timing stays correct because the postDelayed timer wakes the CPU.

The Doze-deferral concern applies equally to the current code *except* that the current code holds a wakelock... no wait, a wakelock doesn't exempt from Doze. Doze suspends network access and defers alarms even for wakelock holders; the wakelock only prevents suspend of the SoC. Actually in Doze, the device does go into suspend even with partial wakelocks held? In practice holding a partial wakelock prevents suspend entirely (that's why wakelocks are so bad for battery). Doze's maintenance windows still allow the app to run, and a partial wakelock held by the app will keep the CPU out of suspend (idle mode), which Doze's "deep idle" is about network batching + alarm deferral, not CPU suspend. So with a permanent wakelock, handler ticks fire every 2s, guaranteed.

If I release the wakelock, the handler tick can be deferred by Doze alarm batching (up to 15 min in deep doze for the app if not allowlisted). That would make keep-alive much less responsive during long idle periods. But honestly — a relaunch in deep doze wouldn't work well anyway (starting an Activity from the background is blocked in Doze). The user experience today with a 2s poll in doze: the relaunch attempt would happen but might be deferred by the system's background-activity-start restrictions. So the practical difference is small, while the battery difference is large.

Given the user asked for battery optimization, I'll implement:
1. Scoped, timeout-bounded wake lock (acquire at tick start, release at end).
2. Adaptive interval with a floor of 2s in the hot state, 5s normal, 15s idle (screen off), and 10s idle with screen on.
3. Screen on/off receiver to immediately switch to the fast interval and to wake up from the long interval (registering ACTION_SCREEN_ON/ACTION_SCREEN_OFF lets the service immediately re-evaluate the interval, so the user never notices a delay when they pick up the phone).
4. Keep the FGS + wake lock permission.

Also: after the screen turns off and everything is stable for a while, we can go to a much longer interval (e.g. 30s) since nothing is visible. Hmm, but keep-alive while the screen is off is exactly the case users want (app killed in background → relaunch). But the relaunch cooldown is 15s, so a 15s poll keeps the same effective SLA as before (worst case 15s late instead of 2s late). Going to 30s doubles the worst case. I'll use 15s as the max interval so the relaunch SLA stays within the existing 15s cooldown — meaning **the feature's effective latency is unchanged**.

Let me be precise: worst-case relaunch delay today = 2s (poll) + 0 (relaunch fires the moment cooldown expires, within 2s). With 15s poll: worst case 15s late. Cooldown is 15s. So effective "time until app is back" goes from ~15-17s to ~15-30s. Hmm, that's a real (if modest) regression in the worst case.

Compromise: when a kept process is detected dead and the cooldown hasn't expired, we know a relaunch is imminent → poll fast (2s) until the cooldown expires and the relaunch happens. That preserves promptness exactly where it matters! That's the key insight: **dead-but-cooling-down → FAST poll**. Then after the relaunch, the app is alive → back off.

But wait: if an app is dead and reluctant (user closed it repeatedly), we'd stay in the fast 2s poll forever. Look at the logic: if `pkg in reluctant || now - lastAliveAt < GAP` → continue (no relaunch). `reluctant` is removed when the app becomes alive again and the gap passed. So a reluctant app stays dead → we'd want slow polling, not fast. So:

- dead && !reluctant && cooldown pending (lastAliveAt + GAP > now) → FAST (relaunch imminent)
- dead && reluctant → IDLE (nothing will happen; user closed it deliberately) → long interval
- dead && cooldown already passed && !reluctant → will relaunch on this very tick (unless launcher focused) → then it becomes alive
- all alive, screen on → NORMAL 5s
- all alive, screen off → IDLE 15s
- pinned with overlay needs showing → NORMAL/FAST

If the launcher is focused and apps are dead, we `continue` (no relaunch) — that could keep us FAST forever while the user stares at the launcher with apps dead. Hmm. In that case the launcher IS the focused foreground app, so relaunches are intentionally blocked. In that state: the launcher is visible, which means the device is being used, so polling isn't a battery issue, but a 2s poll while sitting in the launcher is wasteful. Let me handle: if launcherFocused and dead apps exist → the launcher being focused is only true while our MainActivity is in the foreground (MainActivity on the launcher). So polling fast is pointless → NORMAL. I'll compute `launcherFocused` cheaply and set the interval accordingly.

OK. Design the interval decision:

```kotlin
private fun nextInterval(hasDeadRelaunchPending: Boolean, deadCount: Int, launcherFocused: Boolean, screenOn: Boolean): Long
```

- if deadCount == 0 && overlays.isEmpty() -> stopSelf
- if hasDeadRelaunchPending || justRelaunched -> FAST (2s)
- if deadCount > 0 -> (launcherFocused ? NORMAL : IDLE)  // nothing will happen quickly
- if !screenOn -> IDLE (15s)
- else NORMAL (5s)

Wait, also when overlays exist we want to keep verifying them: the overlay loop hides overlays of dead processes. With deadCount==0 and screen off, 15s is fine.

Now, the `isLauncherFocused` cost: it calls `getRunningTasks(1)`. Only needed when we're about to consider a relaunch (deadCount > 0). If all alive, skip it entirely. That removes the most expensive binder call from the common path.

Let me now write the new watchdog code.

Also `saveState`: currently every 30s unconditionally. Make it dirty-based: set `stateDirty = true` whenever forceRelaunchTime/lastAlive/reluctant/overlays/bounds change, and only write when dirty. But `lastAlive` updates every tick while alive → always dirty. Hmm. So instead: throttle to STATE_SAVE_INTERVAL (raise to 60s) and only write if a *meaningful* field changed (overlays set, bounds, reluctant set, or forceRelaunchTime for some pkg). `lastAlive` is just a timestamp; we don't need it accurate to the second — but it drives the cooldown after a reboot, so stale values could cause an early relaunch. Keep a 60s cadence for `lastAlive` but only when the value meaningfully changed...

Simpler and correct: keep the periodic save but make it cheap and less frequent, and skip the write entirely if nothing that matters changed since the last save. I'll define "matters" as: reluctant set, overlays set, bounds, or any forceRelaunchTime entry that is newer than the last save. And keep saving `lastAlive` on the same cadence. So: compute a small signature of the meaningful state; if unchanged AND `now - lastStateSave < STATE_SAVE_INTERVAL` → skip. That means while everything is stable we write once and then never. That's the win: currently it writes every 30s forever (a disk write + fsync-ish every 30s = 2880 writes/day).

Careful: `lastAlive` changes as time passes, but its *stored* semantics are just "when it was last seen alive". If we stop writing, the value goes stale and on restore `now - lastAlive` becomes large → immediate relaunch on service restart. To avoid that, store a marker: also save when `now - minLastAlive > threshold`? Simplest robust approach: cap staleness by writing at most every 5 minutes, and on restore, if the stored lastAlive is older than the cooldown, treat it as 0 (already expired) — which is what the current code effectively does (large gap → relaunch allowed). That's acceptable: the cooldown protection matters only within the 15s window after a close, and the 5-minute save cadence means worst case the protection window is off by up to 5 min across a *process/service restart* (not across normal operation, since relaunch state lives in memory and the foreground service rarely restarts). Hmm, but "restart" happens when the system kills the service — precisely the scenario keep-alive is meant to survive. If the service is killed and restarts, and the app was closed 3 minutes ago, current code would... let's see: lastAlive stored = 3 min ago, now - lastAlive = 180s > 15s → relaunch allowed. Same as if lastAlive were stale-but-recent. The only difference is the case where the user closed the app and the service died within 15s — with 5 min cadence, the stored lastAlive could be up to 5 min stale = "old" → relaunch allowed immediately, whereas the in-memory value would have blocked it for 15s. Minor and self-correcting (the relaunch marks forceRelaunchTime and enters the normal 15s cooldown afterwards).

I'll use a 120s save cadence, dirty-gated. That's a 4x reduction and, in the common stable case, near-zero writes. Good compromise. Actually let me make it smarter: save when dirty (meaningful change) immediately, else at most every 120s. That's both responsive and cheap.

### Notification
`startForeground` on every onStartCommand with a rebuilt notification. onStartCommand happens on every syncService (every toggle) — fine. But add: only call startForeground if the state actually changed? We must call startForeground within 5s of startForegroundService anyway, so always call it. But we can avoid rebuilding the notification when the text is unchanged by caching the last text and reusing the built Notification object. `startForeground` with the same Notification object still does binder work, but the NotificationManager diffing is cheaper. I'll cache the built notification keyed by the summary text. Minor win, low risk.

### MainActivity

Key changes:
- `runningBase: HashSet<String>` (base package of each running process) and `runningFull: Set<String>` → O(1) `running(pkg)`.
- `loadProcesses()` fills these sets.
- Icon cache: `private val iconCache = HashMap<String, Drawable>()` used by both `buildCard` (via app.icon, already cached in AppEntry) and `buildProcRow`.
- `updateProcessPane()`: compute a signature string; skip rebuild if unchanged and visibility unchanged.
- Adaptive refresh: track consecutive unchanged ticks; interval 2.5s while changing, up to 10s when stable. Also, if there are no kept apps and no process changes... keep simple: 2.5s → 5s → 10s backoff, reset on change. Hmm, "nothing changes" is the common case when sitting on the launcher, so this helps.
- `loadApps()` caching across resumes: keep the app list; on resume, query the package set (cheap) and only rebuild icons if the set differs. This avoids ~200 icon decodes on every resume — a big win.
- Throttle `Updater.check` to once per 6h via SharedPreferences (`Updater` gets a `lastCheckAt` pref, or MainActivity does it). I'll add it in Updater with a pref so it's centralized: store `last_check` in a pref; skip if < 6h. Also store the found version so a failure doesn't retry every resume. Keep it simple: pref `updates` → key `last_check_ms`.
- `updateStats()`: avoid String.format.
- `sig()`: keep, but it now uses O(1) running().

Also `render()` calls `updateProcessPane()` which will be sig-gated.

One more MainActivity battery item: when the activity is in the foreground and the user is idle, the 2.5s poll keeps the screen's CPU awake. Adaptive backoff to 10s when stable is the win.

Also: `onResume` → `checkForUpdate()` every resume. With the 6h throttle, fine.

### AppKeeper
- Throttle prune: companion-level `lastPruneAt` (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime), min interval 30s, and skip if both prefs are empty.
- `isInstalled` does up to 3 binder calls; with the throttle it runs rarely.
- `list()`/`pinnedList()` each call `pruneMissingPackages()` and `prefs.all` (which materializes a map copy each call — SharedPreferencesImpl caches the map, so `all` returns a copy of the cached map; for 200 entries that's a HashMap copy per call). `syncService()` calls `list()` + `pinnedList()`. Called from `set()` which is called from toggles. Not hot. But `AppKeeper` construction in `init` triggers prune. Let me add an in-memory cached list in the instance? Risky with cross-instance writes. Keep it simple: throttle prune, and make `list()` not prune (prune happens on construction and on a throttle timer inside list()). Hmm, `list()` pruning is what keeps stale packages out after an uninstall. I'll keep pruning in `list()`/`pinnedList()` but throttled — same behavior, just less often.

Let me write the code now.

Let me start with KeepAliveService.

In `showOverlay`, `saveState()` is called after adding. Since saveState now resets dirty + lastStateSave, calling it is a direct write. But in the watchdog, `showOverlay` may be called from the tick loop, and then the periodic path calls saveState again → double write. Let me change these to a `persistState()` helper that skips if not dirty:

```kotlin
private fun persistState() {
    if (!stateDirty) return
    saveState()
}
```

And in the watchdog periodic path, call saveState() directly when the interval elapsed (even if not dirty, to refresh `lastAlive` timestamps). That's what I have.

private fun buildNotification(): Notification {
        val targets = activePackages()
        val summary = targets.take(3).joinToString(", ") { pkg ->
            pkg.substringAfterLast('.').ifBlank { pkg }
        }
        val text = if (targets.isEmpty()) "Список пуст" else "Держу живыми: $summary"
        cachedNotification?.takeIf { lastNotificationText == text }?.let { return it }

        val open = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
        )
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        val builder = if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
            Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
        else
            Notification.Builder(this)

        val notification = builder
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_lock_idle_alarm)
            .setContentTitle("APK Launcher")
            .setContentText(text)
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setVisibility(Notification.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC)
            .build()
        lastNotificationText = text
        cachedNotification = notification
        return notification
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        running = false
        saveState()
        handler.removeCallbacks(watchdog)
        for (pkg in overlays.keys.toList()) hideOverlay(pkg, persist = false)
        runCatching { unregisterReceiver(screenReceiver) }
        releaseWakeLock()
        wakeLock = null
        super.onDestroy()
    }

parts.text:
A few issues to review:

1. Line 240-244: `saveState()` now sets `lastStateSave` and `stateDirty=false` internally, so lines 242-243 are redundant. Remove them for clarity.

2. Line 206-213: The original logic for the "dead + cooldown" branch:
```kotlin
if (pkg in reluctant || now - lastAliveAt < RELAUNCH_MIN_GAP_MS) {
    if (lastForced != 0L && now - lastAliveAt < RELAUNCH_MIN_GAP_MS) {
        reluctant.add(pkg)
    }
    continue
}
```
I added `if (pkg !in reluctant) relaunchPending = true` — this makes the interval FAST while a relaunch is pending after the cooldown. Correct: if the package is not reluctant and the cooldown hasn't elapsed, a relaunch is imminent → poll fast (2s) so we relaunch as soon as the cooldown expires. Good. If it IS reluctant, no relaunch will happen → slow.

3. `deadCount > 0` after the loop with `launcherFocused` computed lazily — note `launcherFocused` stays false if no relaunch was ever considered in this tick (all dead ones were in cooldown/reluctant). Then the interval is SLOW. But if the launcher is focused and a package is dead with a passed cooldown, `launcherFocused` gets set true and we skip relaunching → MID. Good.

4. There's a subtle problem: with `deadCount > 0` and `relaunchPending == false` and `launcherFocused == false` (e.g., a reluctant app is dead), we return SLOW (15s). And a pinned overlay for that dead app gets hidden. Fine.

5. Another subtlety: `stateDirty` is set inside the loop via `hideOverlay`, but `hideOverlay` itself now calls `persistState()` which writes when dirty... That means in the loop, `hideOverlay(pkg)` → dirty → immediate `saveState()` (a disk write per dead app per tick). Then the periodic path would skip. Hmm, that's the same number of writes as before in the dead case, but the dead case is transient. Actually, when hideOverlay removes a controller it marks dirty and persists — that's the same as the original behavior (original called saveState() on every hideOverlay call, even when nothing was removed!). My version only persists when a controller was actually removed. Better.

But to avoid double-write inside the tick loop, let me call `hideOverlay(pkg, persist = false)` in the watchdog loop and rely on the dirty flag + periodic save at the end. Same for showOverlay: it calls persistState() → immediate write. In the loop, `showOverlay(pkg)` for a newly detected pinned app — a single write is fine, but let me use `persist = false`-style control. `showOverlay` has no such param. Simplest: in the loop, call `showOverlay(pkg)` and accept the single immediate persist (it's a rare event: a pinned app's overlay being (re)created). For hideOverlay in the loop, use `hideOverlay(pkg, persist = false)` so the write happens once at the end of the tick via the dirty flag.

Let me apply those tweaks.

6. `if (targets.isEmpty() && overlays.isEmpty())` — stopSelf. Good.

7. One more consideration: the "relaunchPending" flag stays true for a package that's in the `now - lastForced < GAP` branch (line 215) → FAST. After a successful relaunch, forceRelaunchTime = now, so for the next 15s we stay in the FAST branch → 2s polls for 15s after each relaunch. That's acceptable (and matches the old behavior of 2s always).

Let me clean up lines 240-244 and the hideOverlay persist flag.

Now I introduced `a.searchKey` and a lowercase `q`. I need to:
1. Add `searchKey` to AppEntry (precomputed lowercase label + package).
2. Ensure `query` is lowercased when set (in the TextWatcher).

Because if a process is named "com.x" then base = "com.x". And if a process is "com.x:svc", base = "com.x". So `runningBase.contains(pkg)` covers both cases. Let me simplify: keep only runningBase. But `runningNames` isn't needed then. Let me remove runningNames to keep it simple.

override fun onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun maybeRequestNotifPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU &&
            checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS), 100)
        }
    }

    private fun checkForUpdate() {
        Updater.check(this, BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME) { latest, url ->
            updateUrl = url
            updateBar.removeAllViews()
            val title = tv("Обновление $latest доступно", 14f, Color.parseColor("#4ade80"), Typeface.BOLD)
            updateBar.addView(title)
            val btns = hBox()
            btns.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            btns.addView(miniBtn("скачать APK") { openUrl(updateUrl) }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            btns.addView(miniBtn("позже") { updateBar.visibility = View.GONE }, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            val blp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            blp.topMargin = dp(8)
            btns.layoutParams = blp
            updateBar.addView(btns)
